neighbours.label: A qualifying 'as' after a duty or instruction (as needed, as far as possible, punished as enemies), mostly in rules and legal text; comparative or temporal 'as' stays quiet
fire: Take two tablets with water as required by your doctor.
The tenant shall, as far as is practicable, repair the fence.
Offenders are to be treated as traitors to the crown.
Replace the filter as necessary during the season.
The trustee must, as soon as possible, inform the court.
Staff should seek further training as appropriate.
Those who refuse shall be regarded as rebels against the state.
Apply the cream to the skin as directed.
quiet: Take two tablets with water when you wake up in bed.

As the crown passed by, the children waved.
Replace the filter before the start of the season.
As soon as she left, the court went quiet.
Staff should wear a badge in the building.
Those who refuse will stay at home with the children.
Use the cream as a mask for the skin.
